extensionDescription.message: Team chat side panel + send current page to your AI agent

storeDesc.message:
TeamClu is a browser extension that opens an AI chat side panel while you browse. Talk to your AI agent and teammates without leaving the page.

Key features:
• Side panel chat — converse with your agent while staying on the current tab
• Page context — on explicit user action, send visible page text, links, or selection to the agent
• Team collaboration — shared sessions, live message sync, and agent replies
• Privacy-first — page content is read only when you trigger capture; no background monitoring

How to use:
1. Click the toolbar icon to open the Chrome side panel
2. Sign in with email (password tab for reviewers — see Test instructions)
3. Pick a team and agent, then start chatting
4. Optionally capture the active tab and send it as conversation context

The extension ships with a pre-configured cloud backend — sign in and go, no server setup required.
